options.description: Look up by domain name (e.g. apple.com)

properties.name: identifier
properties.description: The identifier of the brand. Format depends on the selected Type (e.g. apple.com, AAPL, BTC, US0378331005).

properties.name: domain
properties.description: The domain name of the brand to get context for

properties.name: outputFormat
properties.description: The format the brand context is returned in

options.name: JSON
options.description: Structured JSON object with identity, positioning, and brand voice and style

options.name: Markdown
options.description: Markdown document suitable for use directly in LLM prompts

properties.name: cachedOnly
properties.description: Whether to return the brand context only if one is already cached, responding instantly without crawling the domain. Returns an empty item if no cached context exists.

properties.name: download
properties.description: Whether to download all logo files as binary data
